# Oidcc v3.7.2 - Table of Contents

OpenID Connect client library for the BEAM.

## Pages

- [README](https://oidcc.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [Using private_key_jwt](https://oidcc.hexdocs.pm/private-key-jwt.md)

## Modules

- Erlang
  - [oidcc](https://oidcc.hexdocs.pm/oidcc.md): OpenID Connect High Level Interface
  - [oidcc_auth_util](https://oidcc.hexdocs.pm/oidcc_auth_util.md): Authentication Utilities
  - [oidcc_authorization](https://oidcc.hexdocs.pm/oidcc_authorization.md): Functions to start an OpenID Connect Authorization
  - [oidcc_backoff](https://oidcc.hexdocs.pm/oidcc_backoff.md): Backoff Handling
  - [oidcc_client_context](https://oidcc.hexdocs.pm/oidcc_client_context.md): Client Configuration for authorization, token exchange, and userinfo.
  - [oidcc_client_registration](https://oidcc.hexdocs.pm/oidcc_client_registration.md): Dynamic Client Registration Utilities.
  - [oidcc_decode_util](https://oidcc.hexdocs.pm/oidcc_decode_util.md): Response Decoding Utils
  - [oidcc_http_util](https://oidcc.hexdocs.pm/oidcc_http_util.md): HTTP Client Utilities
  - [oidcc_jwt_util](https://oidcc.hexdocs.pm/oidcc_jwt_util.md): JWT Utilities
  - [oidcc_logout](https://oidcc.hexdocs.pm/oidcc_logout.md): Logout from the OpenID Provider.
  - [oidcc_profile](https://oidcc.hexdocs.pm/oidcc_profile.md): OpenID Profile Utilities
  - [oidcc_provider_configuration](https://oidcc.hexdocs.pm/oidcc_provider_configuration.md): Tooling to load and parse Openid Configuration.
  - [oidcc_provider_configuration_worker](https://oidcc.hexdocs.pm/oidcc_provider_configuration_worker.md): OIDC Config Provider Worker
  - [oidcc_scope](https://oidcc.hexdocs.pm/oidcc_scope.md): OpenID Scope Utilities
  - [oidcc_token](https://oidcc.hexdocs.pm/oidcc_token.md): Facilitate OpenID Code/Token Exchanges.
  - [oidcc_token_introspection](https://oidcc.hexdocs.pm/oidcc_token_introspection.md): OAuth Token Introspection.
  - [oidcc_userinfo](https://oidcc.hexdocs.pm/oidcc_userinfo.md): OpenID Connect Userinfo

- Elixir
  - [Oidcc](https://oidcc.hexdocs.pm/Oidcc.md): OpenID Connect High Level Interface
  - [Oidcc.Authorization](https://oidcc.hexdocs.pm/Oidcc.Authorization.md): Functions to start an OpenID Connect Authorization

  - [Oidcc.ClientRegistration.Response](https://oidcc.hexdocs.pm/Oidcc.ClientRegistration.Response.md): Client Registration Response Struct

  - [Oidcc.Logout](https://oidcc.hexdocs.pm/Oidcc.Logout.md): Logout from the OpenID Provider

  - [Oidcc.ProviderConfiguration](https://oidcc.hexdocs.pm/Oidcc.ProviderConfiguration.md): Tooling to load and parse Openid Configuration
  - [Oidcc.ProviderConfiguration.Worker](https://oidcc.hexdocs.pm/Oidcc.ProviderConfiguration.Worker.md): OIDC Config Provider Worker
  - [Oidcc.Token](https://oidcc.hexdocs.pm/Oidcc.Token.md): Facilitate OpenID Code/Token Exchanges
  - [Oidcc.Token.Access](https://oidcc.hexdocs.pm/Oidcc.Token.Access.md): Access Token struct.
  - [Oidcc.Token.Id](https://oidcc.hexdocs.pm/Oidcc.Token.Id.md): ID Token struct

  - [Oidcc.Token.Refresh](https://oidcc.hexdocs.pm/Oidcc.Token.Refresh.md): Refresh Token struct
